app.title: Device Watchdog
app.subtitle: Monitors devices for connectivity and battery status.

recommendations.hint: Devices whose current threshold ("Hours until 'offline'") doesn't match what's actually been observed.
recommendations.dismissHint: "Dismiss" hides a specific suggestion without applying it - it comes back once the recommendation later changes to a different number. There's currently no dedicated way to undo this here - only a full "Reset" in that device's Details, which also clears every other individual setting for it.
recommendations.minDaysHint: A device observed for less than this won't show up yet, even if it already has enough samples.
recommendations.basisHint: Average gives shorter, more aggressive suggestions - for irregularly-reporting devices (e.g. door/window contacts) you'll likely want a notably higher safety margin below to avoid frequent over-eager suggestions.
recommendations.safetyFactorHint: How much headroom the suggestion adds on top of the longest gap actually observed (default 1.5x). Lower it (e.g. 1.3) for tighter suggestions - can't go below 1.0x, since that would suggest a threshold shorter than a gap you've already seen.
recommendations.empty: No recommendations right now - either every threshold already matches, or there isn't enough data/observation time yet.
recommendations.applyAllConfirm: Apply the recommended threshold to all __count__ listed devices?

devices.testHint: Resends the current value to the device to check reachability (no visible state change).

badge.unreachableHint: Homey currently can't reach this device (connection lost).
badge.notReportingHint: Device is connected according to Homey, but hasn't sent any new data for a while.
badge.filterPinnedHint: No longer matches the active filter after the last change, but stays visible while its details are open here - so you can keep adjusting it without the device vanishing.

info.noStalenessCheckHint: This device only has a momentary button/trigger capability, so Homey never records a "last update" time for it - it can't be checked for stale data and is never flagged "not reporting".

advanced.statsCollecting: Collecting data - __count__ reports seen so far. Either wait for more (a rarely-active device can take a while), or set the threshold above manually based on what you know about this device.
advanced.statsRecommendation: Based on that, a __recommended__h threshold would still catch real problems reliably - yours is currently set to __current__h.
advanced.includeBatteryForReportingHint: On by default: an updated battery reading counts as a sign of life, like any other capability. Disable this for a device whose battery reports independently of its actual measured value, where a frozen temperature/humidity reading would otherwise be masked by the battery still checking in on its own schedule.
advanced.excludeFromUnavailableHint: Only affects the summary trigger, timeline, log, the virtual device's counter, and the dashboard widget. The per-device Flow trigger and condition still work.
advanced.applyToAppButton: Apply to __count__ devices of the same type
advanced.applyToAppQuestion: Apply these settings to __count__ devices of "__app__"? This overwrites those devices' existing per-device settings.
advanced.pausedUntilHint: Device is skipped entirely (like "not monitored") until this date, then resumes automatically on the next scan.
advanced.batteryTypeOverrideHint: Shown instead of the auto-detected battery type (widget and details) - for devices where Homey provides nothing. Leave empty to keep using auto-detection.
advanced.autoTestOnStaleHint: Before this device is flagged "not reporting", resend its current value once as a live reachability test (same as the "Test" button). If that succeeds, the device counts as OK this cycle - useful for devices (e.g. some sirens) that never report on their own and would otherwise need an external script or Flow to "ping" them periodically.
advanced.autoTestTriggerOnHealHint: Off by default: a successful auto-test counts as fully OK, no alert - only the log records it. Enable this to still fire the per-device "not reporting" Flow trigger whenever a nudge was needed, even though the device recovered on its own.
advanced.bulkIgnoreAppQuestion: Stop monitoring __count__ devices managed by "__app__"? Re-enabling is per-device or per-zone.
advanced.bulkIgnoreClassQuestion: Stop monitoring __count__ devices of class "__cls__"? Re-enabling is per-device or per-zone.
advanced.capabilitiesHint: Expand to load this device's current capability values, straight from Homey - the same data Developer Tools shows.
advanced.capabilitiesLegend: 🟢 updated within the __hours__h "Hours until offline" threshold · 🔴 older than that · no colour = not used for this check (e.g. button/battery-only capabilities).
advanced.capabilitiesLegendNone: This device isn't checked for staleness (only battery is checked, or nothing here ever carries a meaningful timestamp), so values below aren't coloured.

recommend.label: Recommendation
recommend.unavailableAppRestart: Several devices from this app dropped at once - usually the app restarting. Raise "Delay before 'unavailable' counts" for these; if it keeps happening, try restarting the app itself.
recommend.unavailableBattery: Battery devices drop off when the battery dies or they sleep too deeply. Check the battery.
recommend.unavailableCheck: Only this device is unreachable. Check its power and range; Zigbee/Z-Wave devices sometimes need re-pairing.
recommend.staleBattery: The battery reading is weeks old - the device may have gone quiet rather than actually being low. Check it directly.
recommend.batteryAlarm: The device is signalling low battery itself. Replace the battery.
recommend.batteryReplace: The battery is at or below the threshold. Time to replace it.
recommend.notMonitorable: This device has nothing that can go stale (trigger-only). Best taken out of monitoring.
recommend.neverReported: This device has never reported any data. If it's only used for Flows or as a display, stop monitoring it - see "Apply to multiple devices" below.
recommend.eventSensor: Contact and motion sensors only report on change, so long quiet gaps are normal. Raise this device's threshold, or set "Count 'last seen'" to Yes.
recommend.tryTest: Homey still sees this device. Try the Test button - if it responds, turn on "Auto-test before flagging".
recommend.silentlyGone: This device hasn't communicated at all recently, but Homey hasn't marked it offline. Check power, battery and range; it may need re-pairing.
recommend.notReportingGeneric: Homey still shows it connected but no new data has arrived. Raise this device's threshold, or if it only reports rarely, turn on "Count 'last seen'".

settingsTab.intervalHint: Off = no background scan. The "Run device scan now" Flow action still always works.
settingsTab.startupGraceHint: Delays only the very first automatic scan after a restart. 0 = immediately.
settingsTab.includeLastSeenHint: Also counts Homey's "last seen" as a sign of life, not just real data changes. Heads up: for most devices, "last seen" moves in lockstep with the last actual value change anyway, so this often makes no practical difference - it only helps the minority of devices whose "last seen" updates independently of that. A connected device whose data is genuinely stuck will also be detected less often with this enabled.
settingsTab.batteryHint: Applies to all devices without their own rule.
settingsTab.lowBatteryDelayHint: 0 = instant. Overridable per device via "Details". Delays the Flow trigger, summary trigger, timeline, log, and the virtual device's counter/alarm - not the live battery status shown in this UI, the widget, or the condition cards. Useful for devices that report a brief 1% blip before recovering. Resolution is bounded by the scan interval - a delay much shorter than that has no effect.
settingsTab.timelineHint: Writes an entry to Homey's timeline as soon as a scan newly finds a device with low battery, not reporting, or unavailable - and again once it recovers. Once per state change, no spam while a problem (or a recovery) persists.
settingsTab.vdAlarmHint: The counters on the virtual Watchdog device always show the real numbers. This only controls which of them trip the summary alarm (alarm_generic).
settingsTab.unavailableDelayHint: 0 = instant. Overridable per device via "Details". Delays the Flow trigger, summary trigger, timeline, log, and the virtual device's counter/alarm - not the live status shown in this UI or the condition cards.
settingsTab.resetHint: Resets all settings (defaults + per-device rules) back to factory defaults. Log and last scan are kept.
settingsTab.resetConfirm: Really reset all settings and per-device rules to factory defaults? This cannot be undone.
settingsTab.resetStatsHint: Clears the collected reporting history for every device (Details > Not reporting > stats). Rebuilds itself from each device's next update.
settingsTab.resetStatsConfirm: Really clear the collected reporting history for every device? This cannot be undone.
settingsTab.pruneRulesHint: Removes per-device rules that point at a device no longer in Homey (e.g. after removing a device). Every other setting is left untouched.
settingsTab.pruneRulesResult: Removed __count__ rule(s) for devices that no longer exist.
settingsTab.pruneRulesNone: No stale rules found - nothing to clean up.
settingsTab.colorThemeHint: Controls whether the settings page follows the system setting or is forced to light/dark.
settingsTab.highContrastHint: Lightens muted/secondary text (hints, timestamps, extra info) further in dark mode - useful in bright ambient light.

supportTab.forumHint: Answers to common questions, and a direct line to the developer, live in the community forum thread.
supportTab.donateHint: Device Watchdog is free and maintained in my spare time. A small donation is always appreciated!

log.autoTestHeal: __device__ needed an auto-test nudge to stay "OK"
log.clearConfirm: Really delete the log? This can't be undone.
